name: The Westin Pasadena
insider_take: Where Old Pasadena's storied charm meets the restorative power of Westin's signature wellness philosophy — this is Southern California sophistication at its most refined.
whats_special: The Westin Pasadena sits in the heart of one of LA's most culturally rich neighborhoods, just steps from Colorado Boulevard — the iconic route of the world-famous Rose Parade. As part of Marriott's Luminous Program, guests enjoy elevated perks and recognition. The hotel's signature Heavenly® Beds live up to the hype, and the heated outdoor pool offers a tranquil escape amid the buzz of vibrant Old Pasadena's dining and shopping scene. With the San Gabriel Mountains as a backdrop, the setting feels grand without being overwhelming.
pro_tip: Book a room with a mountain-facing view for stunning San Gabriel Mountain vistas, especially magical at sunrise. Also, ask about Marriott Luminous benefits at check-in — exclusive upgrades and amenities may be waiting for you!
dont_miss: The world-class Huntington Library, Art Museum & Botanical Gardens is just minutes away — a must for art and garden lovers. Norton Simon Museum, packed with Impressionist masterpieces, is a short stroll away. And of course, Old Pasadena's eclectic mix of restaurants, boutiques, and weekend farmers' markets right outside the hotel doors demands at least an evening of exploration.
pros: Prime Old Town Pasadena location within walking distance of shops, dining, and cultural attractions
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds delivering an exceptionally restful night's sleep
Elegant rooftop pool and fitness center ideal for wellness-focused travelers
Upscale on-site dining and bar offering refined California-inspired cuisine
Marriott Luminous Program benefits including exclusive perks and preferred rates for WhataHotel! guests
cons: Valet parking fees can add a notable daily cost for driving guests
Suburban Pasadena location requires a drive or rideshare to reach downtown Los Angeles attractions
